outcome: Polysialylated neural cell adhesion molecule (PSA-NCAM) protein expression in the hippocampus
cohort: 24 pregnant female Wistar rats were divided into 4 groups (Control, DZN, RV, and DZN + RV) and their fetuses were examined.
finding: Exposure of pregnant mice to DZN significantly decreased PSA-NCAM protein expression in the hippocampus of their fetuses, an effect that was ameliorated by co-administration of RV.
